[P2] Restore invocation records before admitting cloud cases

If Jest exits after Lambda accepts Invoke but before teardown, it leaves a saved invocation record without a quarantine. The workflow permits lifecycle tests after that failure, but this fresh `Cloud` has empty `items`, and `quiesce()` never restores those records. When service visibility exceeds the quiet window, lifecycle cases can begin while the example remains outstanding. Run whole-run settlement before admitting the first case and stop admission if recovery fails. Extend the driver-exit regression through this fixture entry point; its direct `settle_run()` call misses this path.
